request.style: English, female smoky jazz voice, upright bass, brushed drums, piano, muted trumpet, warm mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
My soul waits in silence for God alone
From him comes my salvation
He alone is my rock and my salvation
My stronghold I will never be badly shaken

[Chorus]
Be silent before God alone my soul
For my hope comes from him
He alone is my rock and my salvation
My stronghold I will not be shaken

[Verse]
They plot only to bring him down from his high place
They take pleasure in falsehood
With their mouths they bless but inwardly they curse
How long will you all assail a man

[Chorus]
Be silent before God alone my soul
For my hope comes from him
He alone is my rock and my salvation
My stronghold I will not be shaken

[Bridge]
My salvation and my honor rest on God
My mighty rock my refuge is in God
Trust in him at all times you people
Pour out your hearts before him

[Chorus]
Be silent before God alone my soul
For my hope comes from him
He alone is my rock and my salvation
My stronghold I will not be shaken

[Outro]
God is our refuge
Selah
